steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: What should I say to him...
steps.female_content: What should I say to her...

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: "Thanks for buying me some extra time."

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: No, that's a bit lame. Doesn't match the style of the Garden.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: "I'll remember your kindness. Let's get along well in the future."

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: That sounds too ungrateful... Cough cough...
Coquelic has been hesitating outside the office for a long time, her weak body has even begun to feel tired, but she still hasn't figured out what to say to you.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: So, it failed?

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: Yes... The Chief tried to absorb all the Mania in your body with the shackles, but it wasn't very effective.

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: MBCC almost mobilized all its medical power, and only then were you pulled back from death.

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: We don't know when the Mania will devour you again next time.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: So my life is hanging by a thread. Is that what it is?
Coquelic looks at her palm somewhat dazedly. The red light of the shackles temporarily suppresses the black mist of the Mania.
She lets Sumire comb her hair while staring blankly at the ceiling of the ward. She comes back to her senses after a while.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Where is the Chief? Putting on some melodrama about doing good deeds without leaving a name?

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: He...
Sumire looks away, but Coquelic notices the file that Sumire is trying to hide behind her back.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Give it to me, you're not good enough to fool me.
It's a file with the MBCC stamp on it, containing an important report from the Chief of the Minos Bureau of Crisis Control.

xx, xx, N.F. 113
　　MBCC found traces of a Sinner in Syndicate. After tracking, it's confirmed to be S-Class Sinner Coquelic.
　　According to interrogation and investigation, all members of the Garden were forced to participate in the attack in August under the pressure of the Underground forces.
　　Except for Mentor Coquelic, the rest of the Sinners were killed in the battle with the FAC. The Garden is confirmed to be destroyed.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: But he was there when those children escaped...
steps.female_content: But she was there when those children escaped...

steps.content: She realizes something and suddenly closes the file.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Sumire, this report will be submitted to the 9th Agency, right?

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: I think so? Is there a problem?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: No, nothing. Everything is going just as I wished... It seems he no longer needs my answer.
steps.female_content: No, nothing. Everything is going just as I wished... It seems she no longer needs my answer.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Heh... Sumire, the person you chose, is really interesting.

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: My apologies, Mentor. I don't understand what you mean.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: ${PlayerName}...
She hands back the file.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: He's not as innocent as you think, but also not as untrustworthy as I thought.
steps.female_content: She's not as innocent as you think, but also not as untrustworthy as I thought.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: He did me a huge favor, but he let me see this report before submitting it.
steps.female_content: She did me a huge favor, but she let me see this report before submitting it.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Now... I must go talk to him.
steps.female_content: Now... I must go talk to her.

steps.content: Coquelic gets out of the bed. Sumire wants to help, but Coquelic raises her hand to refuse.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: It's okay. I need to talk to him, just me and him.
steps.female_content: It's okay. I need to talk to her, just me and her.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Whew... I really underestimated you. After enduring so much Mania, you have the strength to write all this nonsense... but didn't even bother to visit me.
Coquelic is walking out of the ward while mumbling something, her steps somewhat unsteady. It's then she notices Sumire looking hesitant by the bed.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: What's wrong with you? You've been acting weird.

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: This report... The Chief had it prepared before deciding to use the shackles to save you.

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: Chief asked me to give this to you if you wake up first, so you don't worry too much.

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: The Chief heard about your past. He knows you hate "self-sacrifice," so he asked me not to tell you about his condition.
steps.female_content: The Chief heard about your past. She knows you hate "self-sacrifice," so she asked me not to tell you about her condition.

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: But... I know I can't hide it from you.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: And what else?
Coquelic seems to have guessed the answer, but she can't help but ask her to keep going.

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: And... he hopes you can believe that the shackles are not a constraint, and the Sinners are not pawns for the MBCC to use.
steps.female_content: And... she hopes you can believe that the shackles are not a constraint, and the Sinners are not pawns for the MBCC to use.

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: His attitude towards the Sinners is just like yours towards the Garden.
steps.female_content: Her attitude towards the Sinners is just like yours towards the Garden.

steps.content: Sumire seems to say something else, but Coquelic is no longer paying attention.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Where is he now?

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: Miss Nightingale said the Chief's condition has improved slightly. The Chief has just moved out of the intensive care ward, but isn't accepting visitors.

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: Should be in the lounge at the moment. I think the Chief should be able to talk and eat now.
After Sumire finishes speaking, she looks up to find that Coquelic is already gone.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: What should I say...
Thank you for seeing through my weakness? Seeing through the selfishness even I don't dare to admit?
Or... blame him for acting like those children who can't protect themselves.
steps.female_content: Or... blame her for acting like those children who can't protect themselves.

steps.content: Coquelic has been struggling with how to start. But the moment she sees the Chief, she's stunned as if she's been struck by lightning.
Wounds, bruises, and remnants of contamination cover the person in front of her. Some of them are left by Rustfire, and some are newly added when sharing the Mania for Coquelic.
She just quietly examines every wound on you, maintaining a subtle distance from you in this not-so-large space.
But it seems she has crossed this distance and seen many people...
Aren't you going to say something?
You didn't come here just to see my wounds, right?
"Don't worry, I've got a lot of stuff inside my body. Your Mania isn't the worst." You really want to say this, but you hold back.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Don't flatter yourself, do I look like the kind of person who would care about your injuries?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Hmm, who knows? You're not actually that cruel, right?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Do you know what Sumire and Gekkabijin say about you?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You're very picky, even a bit dictatorial, but you love the Garden more than anyone else.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Whenever a Garden assassin is in danger, you will grumble and fight twice as hard for them.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You are quite extreme and arrogant. But I have to admit...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You're a good Mentor.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Tsk, is that supposed to be a compliment?
It sounds as if she's complaining, but there is a relieved smile on her face.
Perhaps I know, what I should say now.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Flowers will always wither after they bloom. It's normal. I just want to ask...

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: After what you have done for me, how much time do I have left? A year, a month, or...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It's hard to tell, but the MBCC will do its best.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Okay...
She solemnly fixes her hair and already torn dress, trying to look more serious.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: You can ask anything about Paradeisos, the Underground, the Garden, and me... But there's a condition...

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: You have to promise me three things.

steps.speaker: Gekkabijin
steps.content: Sumire told me you stormed off to see the Chief. It nearly scared her to death.

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: So what were three things you asked for, Mentor?
The ward at night is not as quiet as usual. Sumire is peeling fruit for Coquelic, while Gekkabijin is lying by the bed like a child listening to a story.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: First, the MBCC has to track down all the remaining Garden Sinners in secret, and put the shackles on them to suppress their Mania.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: The old foxes up above and down below may not let us go so easily. I can only have a good beauty sleep if I hand this over to him.
steps.female_content: The old foxes up above and down below may not let us go so easily. I can only have a good beauty sleep if I hand this over to her.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: And the second thing, I hope he'll keep his word...
steps.female_content: And the second thing, I hope she'll keep her word...

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: You won't expose the existence of Garden Sinners?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I won't.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: You won't use shackles to restrain Sinners?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Of course not.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Sinners aren't pawns? They're not tools for you to achieve your grand goals?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: No.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: They are friends, partners, seniors, siblings...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: They are family.

steps.speaker: Gekkabijin
steps.content: A liar has to swallow a thousand needles!

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: What about the third one?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: The third one is, of course, that your Chief can cherish their own life.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: If your Chief keeps charging forward like a wild bull, all my careful planning will go to waste.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Should you be the one to tell me this?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You even went as far as to fight on your own. You exposed yourself, and waged a war against Paradeisos and the Underground. All to sever the chains binding the Garden.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: During this time, you had so many enemies, how much of your own life have you exhausted?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You're no less reckless than me.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Why don't we both abide by the third agreement? I'll stop being reckless, and you should cherish your remaining time. Don't use that power anymore.
Coquelic stops mid-sentence and chuckles, gently patting both Sumire and Gekkabijin on the head.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: What? So engrossed in the story that your sense of perception is dulled?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: There is a guest outside the sickroom. Go and greet her.

steps.speaker: Gekkabijin
steps.content: Guest?

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Mentor, sorry for worrying you.

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: Garofano! I'm glad you're okay...

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Don't worry, Thistle is doing fine as well. It seems like she's made some new friends.

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: It seems that the Chief is already fulfilling the second promise.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Did I interrupt something? What were you talking about?

steps.speaker: Gekkabijin
steps.content: The third promise! Did you agree to it?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Well...

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Ordinary powers can't protect those little fools under my command.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: But at least you are safe for now. If you trust me, then promise me not to fight by draining your own life. As long as you don't use such an outrageous power, the shackles can suppress your Mania.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: But... we will always encounter stronger enemies. One of us has to risk their life.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: I told you, the Chief—

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: I hope flowers can bloom and grow in every corner and in various ways, and use their leaves to cut through all hardships.

steps.speaker: Gekkabijin
steps.content: What kind of answer is that...

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: It sounds more like a wish?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Yes, it's a wish.
My last wish...
I hope that when the next crisis comes, poppies can bloom for you all, shielding you from the sudden rain.
And then, they can wither, rot, and nourish this land.
Gekkabijin, you are qualified as an assassin. I acknowledge you.
Sumire, may thorns no longer grow in the path you chose.
Garofano... you will have to take care of those immature flowers in the future.
Thistle, remember to hold firm to your justice.
Children, if you like that apartment in Syndicate, start a new life there.
No matter how much time is left, a year, a month... it doesn't matter.
Poppies will turn into compost, nurture, accompany, and protect all the seeds forever...

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The Mania flower that Coquelic left in the interrogation room has withered in the storage room.
The adjutant hands over a shriveled evidence bag, the once vibrant flower inside has lost its color.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Has she been here already?
Yes. I also told her that if she used such extreme power again, it would cost her life.
But she didn't give me an answer just now.
This flower is probably her reply. She's refused.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: There's a message... on this flower?
Yeah, I can see it. It says...
The Garden...

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: ...is now in your hands, Chief.
